### ① Derived judgments

**a. One new public export — the widening, named.** `@object-ui/core` gains `recordSourceDataArmForType(type)` (`packages/core/src/utils/record-source.ts`, +110 appended to an existing module; `index.ts` is **comment-only**, the `export *` was already there). A new exported symbol is the mechanical floor ⇒ `Clause-②: yes` is **correct and was mandatory**, ⛔ not a judgement call. ✅ Judged sound: `SchemaRenderer` is generic over every registered type and holds only `schema.type`, so the arm cannot be handed to it as a parameter the way the five plugin call sites receive it.
